title: Dubai NO2 z>1 leads Brent lower 3d (short BZ=F)
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Dubai CAMS NO2 20d z-score above 1.0 (Gulf refining/production pickup) leads Brent lower by 3 days (-); trade short BZ=F 3d - sign reversal of R2-0013 whose long rule had negative excess return pre-war and only a war-sample edge [airquality.dubai.cams_no2 -> finance.BZ=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0013)
message: Not supported: Dubai NO2 z>1 vs Brent r=0.04 (n=390, validity 0); short rule has pre-war excess +0.49%/trade but war-sample hit rate 22% and excess -0.96% - reversal fails out of sample too

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.dubai.cams_no2 rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short BZ=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Null control: London CAMS NO2 20d z-score above 1.0 (no Gulf refining link) leads Brent lower by 3 days (-); trade short BZ=F 3d - if this matches the Dubai NO2 result (R2-0110: r=0.04, pre-war-only edge, war hit rate 22%) the Dubai NO2 signal is regime noise, not a production proxy [airquality.london.cams_no2 -> finance.BZ=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0110)
